name: flmcp
description: Control FL Studio 2024–2026: transport, mixer, channels, plugins, piano roll and music generators.
long_description:
fLMCP lets Claude drive a running FL Studio: set the tempo, program step sequences, write chords and melodies into the piano roll, mix, rename and color tracks, tweak plugin parameters and more (176 tools).

**One-time FL setup.** FL Studio talks to fLMCP through a small MIDI controller script. Close FL Studio, run `uvx flmcp-studio install --no-clients` (on Windows, install loopMIDI first so the installer can create the `fLMCP` port), start FL Studio again and check with `uvx flmcp-studio doctor`. The README covers macOS.

This bundle runs the `flmcp-studio` package from PyPI with uv.

toolsets.title: Tool groups
toolsets.description: Comma-separated groups or presets to expose: all, core, lean, transport, mixer, channels, piano_roll, ... Use 'lean' for small context windows.

timeout.description: How long to wait for FL Studio to answer each call.
